subject.title: feat(webchat): reply-to a message with hydrated reply context

question: Should `chat.send.replyToId` become a supported Gateway/Control UI capability that exposes the selected WebChat transcript message as agent reply context?
rationale: This is a new user-visible Control UI workflow and additive Gateway protocol surface; tests establish the intended mechanics, but maintainer intent is needed to accept the permanent public contract and agent-visible semantics.

options.title: Accept the shared reply contract
options.body: Approve the additive WebChat reply workflow after real behavior proof confirms selection, send or replay, and hydrated agent context.

options.title: Defer the protocol surface
options.body: Keep the existing inline-quote behavior until a maintainer-sponsored design specifies the desired WebChat reply contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared reply contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive WebChat reply workflow after real behavior proof confirms selection, send or replay, and hydrated agent context.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged shared reply-context model and have recently maintained the corresponding Gateway and WebChat integration path.
